name: Plain-text writes refuse the fixed expanded Unicode format set while stored readers keep legacy compatibility
summary: New human-text writes share one fixed expanded set of invisible and direction-changing Unicode format characters, independent of the interpreter's Unicode table. Letter-internal ZWNJ and ZWJ remain accepted exactly as before. Stored review recommendations, reference records, delegations, assignment notices and task-file names use the legacy set when read, so records written before the expanded rule remain readable.
